faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III posts is 24th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Project Technical Support-III position at AIIMS Delhi. These positions are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master’s Degree in Science/Environmental Science/Public Health/Social Sciences/Social Work, or a Bachelor’s Degree with 3 years of experience, or a B.Tech/B.E. in a relevant environmental engineering field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support-III post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month for the Project Technical Support-III role.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support-III posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by a walk-in interview. Candidates are advised to prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official AIIMS Delhi website. The application link and detailed instructions are provided in the article.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a government job or a contractual position?
faq.answer: The Project Technical Support-III positions at AIIMS Delhi are contractual in nature. The job is for a specific project duration.
